The '''Baobab School of Speed Learning''' was an educational institute that taught [[Language/Legends|languages]], including [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]]. The school counted among its tenured faculty several individuals who had been held hostage by Huttese speakers for a period of more than two years, allowing them to gain an excellent grasp of the language. These professors' classes were so popular that that aspiring students were regularly wait-listed.<ref name="Travel Guide" />
